promise: The EU AI Act — 'the world's first comprehensive AI law' — with GPAI transparency obligations applying from 2 August 2025
description: The EU promised a global-first AI regulation with a strict timeline: in force Aug 1, 2024; prohibitions Feb 2, 2025; GPAI (foundation model) obligations Aug 2025; high-risk rules Aug 2026-2027. The deadlines legally held and GPAI duties took effect Aug 2025, but enforcement was staggered and softened — open-source GPAI exemptions granted (June 2025), codes of practice delayed, and high-risk obligations pushed toward 2027.
evidence: AI Act entered into force Aug 1, 2024; GPAI obligations at 12 months (Wikipedia: Artificial Intelligence Act)
High-risk rules split across Aug 2026 (24 months) and Aug 2027 (36 months); open-source exemptions in June 2025
sources: European Commission AI Act fact sheet
